question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this passive durable review-observability and workflow-observer contract as the approved prerequisite architecture for https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674?
rationale: The PR adds new persistent telemetry, API, dashboard health semantics, and a repository workflow rather than repairing an established contract; the correct retention, alerting, and rollout boundary is a maintainer product and operations choice.

options.title: Stage the passive contract
options.body: Approve the passive telemetry/dashboard foundation, require isolated rollout evidence, and then rebase the producer work in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674 onto it.

options.title: Narrow the foundation
options.body: Request a smaller telemetry or dashboard-only prerequisite and defer the workflow observer until the producer protocol is ready.

options.title: Defer observability
options.body: Keep the current review pipeline architecture and reconsider this telemetry model when the item-shard direction is otherwise approved.

recommendation.title: Stage the passive contract
recommendation.body: Approve the passive telemetry/dashboard foundation, require isolated rollout evidence, and then rebase the producer work in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674 onto it.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level workflow and durable-state direction is the deciding concern, and repository policy identifies Peter as the relevant ClawSweeper contact.
